MATCH (d:DocSection {status: 'live'})

  AND (d.repo = s.repo OR (:Repo {name: d.repo})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(:Repo {name: s.repo}))

ON CREATE SET m.resolved = 'late', m.span = row.name
RETURN count(m) AS linked

queries.name: impact
queries.purpose: Every doc section and code example a pull request reaches: changed symbol ← up to 3 callers (any repository) ← doc. The path is the evidence.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (pr:PullRequest {url: $pr})<-[c:CHANGED_IN]-(s:Symbol)
WHERE c.kind <> 'added'

OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:IN_SECTION]->(sec:DocSection)

       t.qualname AS reached, labels(d)[0] AS kind, d.id AS doc, d.repo AS repo, d.path AS path,
       coalesce(sec.id, d.id) AS section, coalesce(sec.heading_path, d.heading_path, d.path) AS heading,
       d.url AS url, length(p) AS hops,
       [n IN nodes(p) | coalesce(n.qualname, n.id)] AS evidence,
       [x IN relationships(p) | coalesce(x.resolved, 'exact')] AS resolution

WITH page, sum(score) AS pageScore, collect({id: id, heading: heading, score: score}) AS sections
UNWIND sections AS sec
WITH page, pageScore, sec
WHERE sec.id IN $ids
RETURN sec.id AS id, sec.heading AS heading, page, pageScore, sec.score AS score
ORDER BY pageScore DESC, score DESC

queries.name: rankSectionsByLinks
queries.purpose: Fallback ranking when graph algorithms are unavailable: inbound links per page.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:DocSection)
WHERE d.id IN $ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (other:DocSection {repo: d.repo, path: d.path})<-[l:LINKS_TO]-()
RETURN d.id AS id, d.heading_path AS heading, d.repo + ':' + d.path AS page, count(l) AS pageScore, 0 AS score
ORDER BY pageScore DESC

queries.name: readSection
queries.purpose: The current text of a doc section, its code examples and its source link.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:DocSection {id: $id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:CodeExample)-[:IN_SECTION]->(d)
WITH d, e ORDER BY e.index
RETURN d.id AS id, d.repo AS repo, d.path AS path, d.heading_path AS heading, d.body AS body, d.url AS url,
       d.lineno AS lineno, d.end_lineno AS endLineno,
       collect(CASE WHEN e IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {id: e.id, lang: e.lang, code: e.code, lineno: e.lineno} END) AS examples

queries.name: exampleForRun
queries.purpose: A code example, the repositories its calls resolve into, and the earlier examples on its page (for stitching fragments).
queries.cypher:
MATCH (e:CodeExample {id: $id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:USES]->(s:Symbol)
WITH e, collect(DISTINCT s.repo) AS usedRepos
OPTIONAL MATCH (prev:CodeExample {repo: e.repo, path: e.path, status: 'live'})
WHERE prev.index < e.index
WITH e, usedRepos, prev
ORDER BY prev.index
RETURN e.id AS id, e.lang AS lang, e.code AS code, e.repo AS repo, e.path AS path, e.url AS url, usedRepos,
       collect(CASE WHEN prev IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {id: prev.id, lang: prev.lang, code: prev.code} END) AS earlier

queries.name: installSet
queries.purpose: Repositories to install for a run: the given ones plus their in-org dependencies (DEPENDS_ON), code repositories only.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (r:Repo)
WHERE r.name IN $repos
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(d:Repo)
WITH collect(DISTINCT r) + collect(DISTINCT d) AS repos
UNWIND repos AS repo
WITH DISTINCT repo
WHERE repo IS NOT NULL AND size(repo.packages) > 0
RETURN repo.name AS repo, repo.sha AS sha
ORDER BY repo

queries.name: cachedRun
queries.purpose: An identical earlier run (same program, same commits): the graph remembers what already ran.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (r:Run {key: $key})
RETURN properties(r) AS props
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1

queries.name: upsertRun
queries.purpose: Record an example execution: status, error line, traceback, commits installed.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (e:CodeExample {id: $example})
MERGE (r:Run {id: $id})
SET r += $props
MERGE (r)-[:OF]->(e)

queries.name: linkRunToPr
queries.purpose: Attach a run to the pull request it was evidence for.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (r:Run {id: $id})
MATCH (pr:PullRequest {url: $pr})
MERGE (r)-[:AT]->(pr)

queries.name: decisionsForSection
queries.purpose: Active decisions governing a doc section directly, or any symbol its prose or examples reach within 2 call hops; superseded decisions resolve to their successor.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:DocSection {id: $id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (dec0:Decision)-[:GOVERNS]->(d)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:MENTIONS]->(:Symbol)-[:CALLS*0..2]->(g1:Symbol)<-[:GOVERNS]-(dec1:Decision)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)<-[:IN_SECTION]-(:CodeExample)-[:USES]->(:Symbol)-[:CALLS*0..2]->(g2:Symbol)<-[:GOVERNS]-(dec2:Decision)
WITH collect(DISTINCT {dec: dec0, via: d.heading_path}) + collect(DISTINCT {dec: dec1, via: g1.qualname})
     + collect(DISTINCT {dec: dec2, via: g2.qualname}) AS hits
UNWIND hits AS hit
WITH hit.dec AS dec, hit.via AS via
WHERE dec IS NOT NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (newer:Decision {status: 'active'})-[:SUPERSEDES*1..10]->(dec)
WITH coalesce(newer, dec) AS current, dec AS matched, via
WHERE current.status = 'active'
RETURN DISTINCT current.id AS id, current.text AS text, current.source_url AS source, current.author AS author,
       current.created_at AS createdAt, matched.id AS matched, via

queries.name: decisionsForSymbol
queries.purpose: Active decisions governing a symbol or anything it calls within 2 hops; superseded decisions resolve to their successor.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Symbol {id: $id})-[:CALLS*0..2]->(g:Symbol)<-[:GOVERNS]-(dec:Decision)
OPTIONAL MATCH (newer:Decision {status: 'active'})-[:SUPERSEDES*1..10]->(dec)
WITH coalesce(newer, dec) AS current, dec AS matched, g.qualname AS via
WHERE current.status = 'active'
RETURN DISTINCT current.id AS id, current.text AS text, current.source_url AS source, current.author AS author,
       current.created_at AS createdAt, matched.id AS matched, via

queries.name: priorVerdicts
queries.purpose: What Lockstep concluded about this section on earlier pull requests, and what maintainers did with it.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (v:Verdict)-[:ABOUT]->(:DocSection {id: $id})
MATCH (v)-[:FOR]->(pr:PullRequest)
RETURN v.id AS id, v.verdict AS verdict, v.status AS status, v.reason AS reason, pr.url AS pr, pr.title AS title, v.created_at AS createdAt
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5

queries.name: createDecision
queries.purpose: Record a maintainer decision.
queries.cypher:
CREATE (dec:Decision {id: $id})
SET dec += $props
RETURN dec.id AS id

queries.name: governSections
queries.purpose: Attach a decision to the doc sections it governs.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (dec:Decision {id: $id})
MATCH (d:DocSection)
WHERE d.id IN $governs
MERGE (dec)-[:GOVERNS]->(d)
RETURN count(d) AS n

queries.name: governSymbols
queries.purpose: Attach a decision to the symbols it governs.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (dec:Decision {id: $id})
MATCH (s:Symbol)
WHERE s.id IN $governs
MERGE (dec)-[:GOVERNS]->(s)
RETURN count(s) AS n

queries.name: supersedeDecision
queries.purpose: Mark an older decision superseded by a newer one.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (newer:Decision {id: $newer})
MATCH (older:Decision {id: $older})
MERGE (newer)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(older)
SET older.status = 'superseded'

queries.name: createVerdict
queries.purpose: Record the agent's verdict on one section for one pull request, with the decisions and runs it cites.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:DocSection {id: $section})
MATCH (pr:PullRequest {url: $pr})
CREATE (v:Verdict {id: $id})
SET v += $props
MERGE (v)-[:ABOUT]->(d)
MERGE (v)-[:FOR]->(pr)
WITH v
OPTIONAL MATCH (dec:Decision) WHERE dec.id IN $cites
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN dec IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [1] END | MERGE (v)-[:CITES]->(dec))
WITH DISTINCT v
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Run) WHERE r.id IN $runs
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [1] END | MERGE (v)-[:EVIDENCE]->(r))
RETURN DISTINCT v.id AS id

queries.name: sectionReachedByPr
queries.purpose: Guard for edits: is there a path from this pull request's changes to the section (or one of its examples)?
queries.cypher:
MATCH (pr:PullRequest {url: $pr})<-[c:CHANGED_IN]-(s:Symbol)
WHERE c.kind <> 'added'
MATCH p = (s)<-[:CALLS*0..3]-(:Symbol)<-[:MENTIONS|USES]-(d)
WHERE d.id = $section OR (d)-[:IN_SECTION]->(:DocSection {id: $section})
WITH p
ORDER BY length(p)
LIMIT 1
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | coalesce(n.qualname, n.id)] AS path

queries.name: verdictsForPr
queries.purpose: The latest verdict per section for a pull request (what the docs patch is built from).
queries.cypher:
MATCH (v:Verdict)-[:FOR]->(:PullRequest {url: $pr})
MATCH (v)-[:ABOUT]->(d:DocSection)
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:CITES]->(dec:Decision)
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[:EVIDENCE]->(r:Run)
WITH v, d, collect(DISTINCT dec.id) AS cites, collect(DISTINCT {id: r.id, status: r.status, side: r.side, error: r.error}) AS runs
ORDER BY v.created_at DESC
WITH d, collect({v: v, cites: cites, runs: runs})[0] AS latest
RETURN d.id AS section, d.repo AS repo, d.path AS path, d.heading_path AS heading, d.lineno AS lineno,
       d.end_lineno AS endLineno, d.url AS url, latest.v.id AS id, latest.v.verdict AS verdict,
       latest.v.status AS status, latest.v.reason AS reason, latest.v.new_text AS newText,
       latest.v.old_text AS oldText, latest.v.evidence AS evidence, latest.cites AS cites, latest.runs AS runs
ORDER BY repo, path, lineno

queries.name: reviewVerdict
queries.purpose: A maintainer accepts or rejects a verdict; precision is measured from these.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (v:Verdict {id: $id})
SET v.status = $status, v.reviewed_by = $by, v.reviewed_at = $at
RETURN v.id AS id

queries.name: sinceLastCheck
queries.purpose: What changed in the graph since a moment: pull requests checked, verdicts, decisions, runs.
queries.cypher:
OPTIONAL MATCH (pr:PullRequest) WHERE pr.ingested_at > $since
WITH collect(DISTINCT {url: pr.url, title: pr.title}) AS prs
OPTIONAL MATCH (v:Verdict) WHERE v.created_at > $since
WITH prs, count(v) AS verdicts, sum(CASE WHEN v.verdict = 'stale' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stale
OPTIONAL MATCH (dec:Decision) WHERE dec.created_at > $since
WITH prs, verdicts, stale, collect(DISTINCT {id: dec.id, text: dec.text}) AS decisions
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Run) WHERE r.created_at > $since
RETURN prs, verdicts, stale, decisions, count(r) AS runs,
       sum(CASE WHEN r.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedRuns

queries.name: lastCheck
queries.purpose: When the previous agent check ran (for "since your last run").
queries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Check)
WHERE c.status <> 'running'
RETURN c.id AS id, c.started_at AS startedAt, c.pr AS pr
ORDER BY c.started_at DESC
LIMIT 1

queries.name: createCheck
queries.purpose: Start an agent check of a pull request.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (pr:PullRequest {url: $pr})
CREATE (c:Check {id: $id})
SET c += $props
MERGE (c)-[:FOR]->(pr)

queries.name: finishCheck
queries.purpose: Close an agent check: status, summary, and the full trace (every tool call with its Cypher).
queries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Check {id: $id})
SET c += $props
WITH c
MATCH (v:Verdict {check: $id})
MERGE (c)-[:PRODUCED]->(v)
RETURN count(v) AS verdicts

queries.name: sectionsWithVerdict
queries.purpose: Sections that received a verdict during this check (the stop condition).
queries.cypher:
MATCH (v:Verdict {check: $id})-[:ABOUT]->(d:DocSection)
RETURN DISTINCT d.id AS id

queries.name: recentChecks
queries.purpose: Agent checks, newest first.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Check)-[:FOR]->(pr:PullRequest)
RETURN c.id AS id, pr.url AS pr, pr.title AS title, c.status AS status, c.model AS model, c.started_at AS startedAt,
       c.finished_at AS finishedAt, c.steps AS steps, c.tool_calls AS toolCalls, c.verdicts AS verdicts, c.summary AS summary,
       c.tool_order AS toolOrder
ORDER BY startedAt DESC
LIMIT $limit

queries.name: checkTrace
queries.purpose: The stored trace of one agent check.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (c:Check {id: $id})
RETURN c.trace AS trace

queries.name: upsertRepo
queries.purpose: Create or refresh a repository node.
queries.cypher:
MERGE (r:Repo {name: $name})
SET r += $props

queries.name: upsertFiles
queries.purpose: Create or refresh files and attach them to their repository.
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (f:File {id: row.id})
SET f += row.props, f.seen = $run
WITH f, row
MATCH (r:Repo {name: row.repo})
MERGE (f)-[:IN_REPO]->(r)

queries.name: upsertSymbols
queries.purpose: Create or refresh symbols (modules, classes, functions, methods) in their files.
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (s:Symbol {id: row.id})
SET s += row.props, s.status = 'live', s.seen = $run
WITH s, row
MATCH (f:File {id: row.file})
MERGE (s)-[:DEFINED_IN]->(f)

queries.name: deleteRepoCalls
queries.purpose: Drop the outgoing call edges of a repository before re-resolving them.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Symbol {repo: $repo})-[c:CALLS]->()
DELETE c

queries.name: upsertCalls
queries.purpose: Write resolved call edges (exact = through imports and types; by-name = name match in an imported repository).
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MATCH (a:Symbol {id: row.from})
MATCH (b:Symbol {id: row.to})
MERGE (a)-[c:CALLS]->(b)
SET c.resolved = row.resolved, c.line = row.line, c.text = row.text

queries.name: markGoneSymbols
queries.purpose: Symbols no longer in the repository are kept (verdicts and decisions point at them) but marked gone.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Symbol {repo: $repo})
WHERE s.seen <> $run AND s.status = 'live'
SET s.status = 'gone'
RETURN count(s) AS gone

queries.name: upsertDependsOn
queries.purpose: Record that one repository depends on another (from pyproject/requirements).
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MATCH (a:Repo {name: row.from})
MATCH (b:Repo {name: row.to})
MERGE (a)-[d:DEPENDS_ON]->(b)
SET d.spec = row.spec

queries.name: upsertSections
queries.purpose: Create or refresh doc sections (one per heading) with their text and identifiers.
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (d:DocSection {id: row.id})
SET d += row.props, d.status = 'live', d.seen = $run
WITH d, row
MATCH (f:File {id: row.file})
MERGE (d)-[:DEFINED_IN]->(f)

queries.name: upsertExamples
queries.purpose: Create or refresh code examples (fenced blocks and example scripts) and place them in their section.
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MERGE (e:CodeExample {id: row.id})
SET e += row.props, e.status = 'live', e.seen = $run
WITH e, row
MATCH (f:File {id: row.file})
MERGE (e)-[:DEFINED_IN]->(f)
WITH e, row
OPTIONAL MATCH (d:DocSection {id: row.section})
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN d IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [1] END | MERGE (e)-[:IN_SECTION]->(d))

queries.name: deleteRepoDocEdges
queries.purpose: Drop a docs repository's MENTIONS/USES/LINKS_TO edges before re-linking.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d {repo: $repo})-[r:MENTIONS|USES|LINKS_TO]->()
WHERE d:DocSection OR d:CodeExample
DELETE r

queries.name: upsertMentions
queries.purpose: Link a doc section to a symbol its prose names in inline code.
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MATCH (d:DocSection {id: row.from})
MATCH (s:Symbol {id: row.to})
MERGE (d)-[m:MENTIONS]->(s)
SET m.span = row.span, m.resolved = row.resolved

queries.name: upsertUses
queries.purpose: Link a code example to a symbol it calls (resolved like code: imports, then types).
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MATCH (e:CodeExample {id: row.from})
MATCH (s:Symbol {id: row.to})
MERGE (e)-[u:USES]->(s)
SET u.line = row.line, u.resolved = row.resolved, u.text = row.text

queries.name: upsertLinks
queries.purpose: Link doc sections that hyperlink to each other (input to PageRank).
queries.cypher:
UNWIND $rows AS row
MATCH (a:DocSection {id: row.from})
MATCH (b:DocSection {id: row.to})
MERGE (a)-[:LINKS_TO]->(b)

queries.name: markGoneDocs
queries.purpose: Doc sections and examples no longer present are kept but marked gone.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (d {repo: $repo})
WHERE (d:DocSection OR d:CodeExample) AND d.seen <> $run AND d.status = 'live'
SET d.status = 'gone'
RETURN count(d) AS gone

queries.name: repoSymbols
queries.purpose: List the live symbols of a repository.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Symbol {repo: $repo, status: 'live'})
RETURN s.id AS id, s.qualname AS qualname, s.kind AS kind, s.signature AS signature
ORDER BY s.qualname

queries.name: callsFrom
queries.purpose: Outgoing calls of one symbol.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (a:Symbol {id: $id})-[c:CALLS]->(b:Symbol)
RETURN b.id AS to, c.resolved AS resolved, c.line AS line
ORDER BY b.id

queries.name: graphCounts
queries.purpose: Live node counts for FACTS.md (symbols and docs a re-index marked gone, or a PR removed, are not counted).
queries.cypher:
MATCH (n)
WHERE NOT (n:Symbol OR n:DocSection OR n:CodeExample) OR n.status = 'live'
RETURN labels(n)[0] AS label, count(n) AS n
ORDER BY label

queries.name: edgeCounts
queries.purpose: Edge counts by type for FACTS.md.
queries.cypher:
MATCH ()-[r]->()
RETURN type(r) AS type, count(r) AS n
ORDER BY type

queries.name: factsRepos
queries.purpose: Per-repository counts for FACTS.md.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (r:Repo)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Symbol {repo: r.name, status: 'live'})
WITH r, count(s) AS symbols
OPTIONAL MATCH (d:DocSection {repo: r.name, status: 'live'})
WITH r, symbols, count(d) AS sections
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:CodeExample {repo: r.name, status: 'live'})
RETURN r.name AS name, r.sha AS sha, r.packages AS packages, symbols, sections, count(e) AS examples,
       sum(CASE WHEN e.lang = 'python' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pythonExamples
ORDER BY name

queries.name: factsCalls
queries.purpose: How CALLS edges were resolved, and how many cross repositories.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (a:Symbol)-[c:CALLS]->(b:Symbol)
RETURN sum(CASE WHEN c.resolved = 'exact' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact,
       sum(CASE WHEN c.resolved = 'by-name' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS byName,
       sum(CASE WHEN a.repo <> b.repo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crossRepo

queries.name: factsUses
queries.purpose: How USES edges (example → symbol) were resolved.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (:CodeExample)-[u:USES]->(:Symbol)
RETURN sum(CASE WHEN u.resolved = 'exact' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact,
       sum(CASE WHEN u.resolved = 'by-name' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS byName

queries.name: factsDependsOn
queries.purpose: Repository dependency edges.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (a:Repo)-[d:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Repo)
RETURN a.name AS from, b.name AS to, d.spec AS spec
ORDER BY from, to

queries.name: factsCrossRepoDocPaths
queries.purpose: Symbol → doc pairs connected through ≤ 3 call hops where the doc lives in another repository.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Symbol {status: 'live'})
MATCH (s)<-[:CALLS*0..3]-(:Symbol)<-[:MENTIONS|USES]-(d)
WHERE (d:DocSection OR d:CodeExample) AND s.repo <> d.repo
RETURN count(DISTINCT s.id + '|' + d.id) AS n

queries.name: factsSamplePaths
queries.purpose: For public symbols, the longest path where a call crosses a repository boundary before reaching a doc.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Symbol {status: 'live', visibility: 'public'})
WHERE NOT s.qualname CONTAINS '._'
MATCH p = (s)<-[:CALLS*1..3]-(t:Symbol)<-[:MENTIONS|USES]-(d)
WHERE (d:DocSection OR d:CodeExample) AND s.repo <> t.repo
WITH s, d, p
ORDER BY length(p) DESC, d.id
WITH s, collect({doc: d.id, hops: length(p), path: [n IN nodes(p) | coalesce(n.qualname, n.id)]})[0] AS best
RETURN s.qualname AS symbol, best.doc AS doc, best.hops AS hops, best.path AS path
ORDER BY hops DESC, symbol
LIMIT 5

queries.name: factsPullRequests
queries.purpose: Pull requests checked so far, with how many symbols they changed and how many doc sections those reach.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (pr:PullRequest)
OPTIONAL MATCH (pr)<-[c:CHANGED_IN]-(s:Symbol)
WHERE c.kind <> 'added'
WITH pr, collect(s) AS changed
OPTIONAL MATCH (pr)<-[c2:CHANGED_IN]-(s2:Symbol)<-[:CALLS*0..3]-(:Symbol)<-[:MENTIONS|USES]-(d)
WHERE c2.kind <> 'added' AND (d:DocSection OR d:CodeExample) AND d.status = 'live'
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:IN_SECTION]->(sec:DocSection)
WITH pr, changed, collect(DISTINCT coalesce(sec.id, d.id)) AS sections,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.repo <> pr.repo THEN coalesce(sec.id, d.id) END) AS elsewhere
RETURN pr.url AS url, pr.title AS title, size(changed) AS changed, size(sections) AS sections,
       size(elsewhere) AS otherRepos
ORDER BY url

queries.name: factsRuns
queries.purpose: Every recorded example execution, latest first per example and side.
queries.cypher:
MATCH (r:Run)-[:OF]->(e:CodeExample)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:AT]->(pr:PullRequest)
RETURN e.id AS example, e.url AS url, r.side AS side, r.status AS status, r.error AS error, r.reason AS reason,
       r.installed AS installed, pr.url AS pr, r.created_at AS at
ORDER BY example, at DESC

queries.name: impactFromSymbol
queries.purpose: Docs reachable from one symbol (FACTS timing; the PR-scoped version is the impact tool).
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Symbol {qualname: $qualname})
MATCH p = (s)<-[:CALLS*0..3]-(t:Symbol)<-[:MENTIONS|USES]-(d)
WHERE d:DocSection OR d:CodeExample
RETURN d.id AS doc, length(p) AS hops

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Find every doc section and code example a pull request can falsify, in any repository of the organisation. Walks changed symbol ← callers (up to max_hops, across repositories) ← MENTIONS/USES ← doc. Returns impacted sections ordered by severity (breaking: removed/renamed; api: signature; behavior: body changed) with the evidence path for each. Call this first for a PR.

tools.name: clearance
tools.description: Proof of absence: the changed symbols that reach no doc section or example within 3 call hops in any repository. Each comes with a git grep command and its raw text-match count so a human can check the claim.

tools.name: read_section
tools.description: Read the current Markdown of a doc section and its code examples, before deciding whether and how to edit it.

tools.name: run_example
tools.description: Execute a docs code example in a sandbox (fresh virtualenv with the repositories installed from source, scratch FalkorDB on localhost:6379, no other network). With pr_url it runs twice — at the commit before the PR and at the PR — so "passes before, fails after" proves the PR broke the example. Examples needing LLM keys, local files or placeholders are recorded as skipped with the reason. Identical runs are answered from the graph.

tools.name: decisions_for
tools.description: Before judging a doc section, read the maintainers' decisions that govern it (directly, or through any symbol it mentions or its examples use, within 2 call hops; superseded decisions resolve to the current one) and the verdicts Lockstep gave this section on earlier pull requests (with whether maintainers accepted them). A governing decision can mean the section is intentionally as it is: cite it instead of editing.

tools.name: rank_sections
tools.description: Order doc sections by how central their page is in the docs (PageRank over LINKS_TO, summed per page), so the most-read stale page is fixed first.

tools.name: propose_edit
tools.description: Propose replacement Markdown for a stale doc section (the whole section, heading line included, as read_section returned it). Refused unless the graph has a path from this pull request's changes to the section: Lockstep never edits a paragraph without one. Keep everything that is still true; change only what the PR falsified. Cite runs that prove the break when you have them.

tools.name: record_verdict
tools.description: Close impacted sections without editing them: ok (the change does not falsify it — say why, e.g. the example passed before and after), governed (a decision says it stays as is — cite the decision id), or skipped (cannot be judged — say why). Pass several section_ids when one reason covers them all. Every impacted section needs a verdict or an edit before you finish.

tools.name: write_decision
tools.description: Record a maintainer decision ("the async client keeps the old kwargs until 2.0") and the doc sections or symbols it governs. Future checks cite it instead of re-flagging. Decisions come from people: call this only when a human asked for it.
